quotations.english: the people of Wessex provided the Danes with horses

quotations.old_english: Hé beád ðæt man sceolde his here metian and horsian

source_text: horsian; p. ode To horse, provide with horses :-- West Seaxe horsodon ðone here the people of Wessex provided the Danes with horses, Chr. 1015; Erl. 153, 1. Hé beád ðæt man sceolde his here metian and horsian, 1013; Erl. 148. 3: 1014; Erl. 151, 2. DER. be-, ge-horsian.
